name: Cook fake Tandoor
short_desc: Fake Tandoor with invented recipes for testing Cook dev builds. Start only while testing.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: A fake Tandoor Recipes server with invented demo data (user test / test), the Demo profile of Cook's dev builds. Everything is in memory: a restart resets it, nothing real is stored, and it never talks to your real Tandoor. Start it only while testing and stop it afterwards (capped at 64 MB and a quarter CPU).
